title: ever ALYNA|Sparkly High-Low Cruise Journey Dress
descriptionHtml:
Perfect for cruise evenings, this high-low dress features a sparkling, eye-catching design with a flowy hemline that creates a graceful silhouette. The shimmering fabric adds glamour, while the comfortable fit makes it ideal for dancing and celebrating onboard. A stylish choice for unforgettable cruise nights.


Similar Version:High Low Party Dresses


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length:Knee length/High-low.


Closure: It is concealed Zipper up the Back.


Undergarments: It is not Padded , no Lining.


Material: Shell:100%Polyester, 
Lining:100%Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.
